summary_en: Credit Saison authorized the acquisition of up to 6.0 million shares (4.1% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 20 billion yen through open market purchases between November 16, 2026 and February 26, 2027, with all acquired shares to be cancelled on March 31, 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
Credit Saison's board of directors resolved on November 13, 2026 to acquire up to 6.0 million shares of its own common stock for a maximum of 20 billion yen through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The acquisition period runs from November 16, 2026 through February 26, 2027. The company stated the buyback is part of its capital allocation policy, taking into account progress of the 2024-2026 medium-term management plan, financial outlook, and stock price conditions.

All shares acquired under this authorization will be cancelled on March 31, 2027. Based on treasury stock holdings as of October 31, 2026, the company held 145,041,495 shares outstanding (excluding treasury stock) and 16,061,075 treasury shares. The 6.0 million share authorization represents 4.1% of outstanding shares as of that date. The final number of shares to be cancelled will be announced upon completion of the acquisition.
